# Configuration schema (C033-C036)

Layers, lowest to highest precedence: defaults < environment < site < tenant < session. Tenant and session layers may only lower numeric ceilings. `LOCKED` fields cannot be changed by any layer. Unknown fields are rejected. Duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Infinity and documents over 262144 bytes are rejected before use.
